name: Dangerous ATV Driving
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Dangerous ATV Driving! 🔥

🚗Drive through dangerous Western Cliffs, to shark-infested Sandy Beaches, giant Snowy Mountains, and much MORE!
✅Arrive at checkpoints, complete worlds, earn 💸 and BUY your first brand-new ATV!
⏳Race AND ride with your friends. Find rare hidden badges in EACH map!
There are 8 UNIQUE maps, can you COMPLETE all of them❔

🤔Do YOU have what it takes to conquer these dangerous roads❓

👍 Join our community and like the game for a FREE Golf Cart!
